policy.catalog: Frozen unique movies in canonical training feedback; no new titles are inferred.
policy.profile: Mean of L2-normalized feature rows for rated movies >= 4, per group; divide by covered likes only.
policy.exclusion: Exclude every rated catalog movie, including dislikes.
policy.scaling: Each group divided by its unseen maximum; missing content falls back to its base.
policy.blend: Blend CF/plots, then selected credit groups, re-scale unseen, add IMDb weight times centered adjustment.
policy.coldStart: With no likes: training rating count descending, IMDb adjustment descending, movieId ascending.
policy.tieBreak: Personalized score descending, training rating count descending, movieId ascending.
policy.newUsers: New profiles fold into the frozen collaborative item basis without adding a training-user dimension.
policy.precision: Little-endian float32 sparse values, float64 profile/scoring accumulations.

limitations: Current IMDb snapshot may include votes after MovieLens timestamps.
Validation-selected model; live-user quality has not yet been measured.

verification.coldStartParityException: Product cold start uses popularity then IMDb instead of IMDb alone.
